context: A husband and wife plan slow weekend mornings
purpose: Teach: ワケ/さほど/ストック/めぐり/トータル/ボディ/スロー/主として

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 週末くらいスローライフって感じで過ごしたいんだよね、せかせかしてばっかりだとさ。
lines.en: On weekends I want to live a 'slow life' kind of vibe, you know, since I'm always rushing.
lines.style: Relaxed, warm husband voice easing into the weekend mood.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: わかる。私もそういうのが主として理想なの。今日は何も予定入れてないよ。
lines.en: I get it. That's mainly my ideal too. I haven't scheduled anything today.
lines.style: Gentle, content wife smiling over her morning cup softly.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: コーヒー豆のストック、まだ残ってたっけ?切らしてたら買いに行かなきゃだけど。
lines.en: Is there still some coffee bean stock left? If we're out, I'll have to go buy more.
lines.style: Casual, slightly playful husband peeking into the kitchen cabinet.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昨日買ったばっかりだから大丈夫。それより新しいボディソープ使ってみた?
lines.en: I bought some just yesterday so we're fine. More importantly, did you try the new body soap?
lines.style: Soft, curious wife changing the subject with light interest.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、香りすごくよかった。なんでそんなに気に入ったのか自分でもワケわかんないけど。
lines.en: Yeah, the scent was amazing. I can't even figure out why I liked it so much, honestly.
lines.style: Amused, slightly laughing husband shrugging at himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、よかった。ねえ、朝ご飯のあと近所をめぐりながら散歩しない?
lines.en: Hehe, glad to hear it. Hey, after breakfast want to wander the neighborhood for a walk?
lines.style: Warm, inviting wife suggesting a peaceful shared activity gently.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいね。トータルで一時間くらいかな?帰りにあのパン屋寄りたいし。
lines.en: Sounds great. About an hour total, maybe? I want to stop by that bakery on the way back.
lines.style: Enthusiastic but mellow husband mapping out the route happily.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 決まりね。今日はさほど暑くなさそうだし、ちょうどいいお散歩日和だよ。
lines.en: It's decided then. It doesn't seem that hot today, so it's perfect walking weather.
lines.style: Affectionate, slightly nurturing wife glancing out the window cheerfully.
